title: Report theft
summary: Use the NSW Police Force Community Portal to create an online report for theft or stealing.
intro:
Theft is when someone has taken your property without your permission and with no intention of returning it.

You can create an online theft or stealing report using the NSW Police Force Community Portal, if:

If the incident is an emergency or occurring now, call Triple Zero (000) immediately.
who_can_apply: Stealing of an animal (pet or livestock)
Vehicle theft (such as a car, motorbike, boat, trailer, caravan, truck, heavy plant or aircraft)
what_you_need: Details of the theft or failure to pay
The location, date and time of the incident
A description of the stolen property or the goods and services not paid for

how_to_steps.text: Complete the Theft Triage Process to be directed to the appropriate online form.

internal_links.text: Report identity theft, scams or cybercrime
Report an incident to Crime Stoppers
Report your E-Tag as lost or stolen
Report a vessel or engine as stolen
Report intentional damage or graffiti to NSW Police
Access the NSW Police Force Community Portal

faqs.q: What should I do if the theft is an emergency?
faqs.a: If the incident is an emergency or occurring now, call Triple Zero (000) immediately.
Anyone can report theft online, even if you live interstate or overseas, or are reporting on behalf of a business.

faqs.q: What types of theft can I report online?
faqs.a: Examples include burglary or housebreaking, shoplifting, stealing an animal, or theft of a vehicle.
